body:
AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 continuation (#7947–#7954): audited all five payload PRs against their full bodies, diffs, source issues and discussion. Applied and read back `audit:complete` on #7947, #7951 and #7954, `audit:completed-later` on #7952, and `audit:partial` on #7953. The #7952 probe was followed by fix PR #9007; #7953's remaining cross-server scope is already recorded for Lane 2 at #13871. See [the #7947–#7954 audit record](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7947-7954/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7947-7954.md).

Cumulative progress: **166 valid PRs audited from 170 payload identifiers**; the four invalid identifiers are #7667, #7668, #7693 and #7694. **80 identifiers remain; next #7955.**
